title: CRS-6 First Stage Landing
summary: SpaceX's official footage of the CRS-6 Falcon 9 first stage landing attempt, in high resolution and slow motion. It shows the descent and touchdown on the drone ship.
why: HN uses it as a reference clip for examining landing behavior such as engine gimballing, and comparing against failed early landings.

quote.text: High resolution, color corrected, slow motion rocket landing video
